text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Here I go! Even if I'm dragging my feet,
I'm still
gonna keep pushing forward,
step by step!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I gotta keep my eyes on the goal and
keep
inching forward! Dia will overtake
me in a
heartbeat if I get complacent.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(After all, I debuted first, but she's
already
caught up!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, we're waiting for
Satono
Diamond to discuss our next
partner run, when...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's taking Dia so long...
She's usually
never late for anything.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um... She did say she had something
important to
talk about with her family
today, but I've got no
idea what it's
about...
choice_data_list: 何か言ってなかったか？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita! Sorry I'm late.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dia! It's no biggie. Did something
keep you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's something that I need to
tell the
both of you...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You see... um... I...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can't run with you anymore, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! What do you mean?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Don't get the wrong idea. I'm not leaving
Tracen
Academy or anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's just impossible for me to run in the
same year
with you. My family and I
came to that conclusion
after talking
with a physician today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing I can do to change
things...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, do you mean...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's all I needed to hear to understand
the
situation. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Correct, I'm not.
choice_data_list: まだ本格化に入ってないってことか
まだ本格化に入ってないってことだよね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When an Uma is race-ready, it means
she's in the
stage of her life where she
improves rapidly and
her racing
capabilities are at their peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The timing is different for everyone,
though.
Kitasan Black has already
entered it, but it seems
Satono Diamond
hasn't.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Training with you made me realize that
might be
the case.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You were improving day by day while I
remained
stagnant. That's when it
started to click.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But... But if we're in different years, then
we won't
be able to run in the Satsuki
Sho or the Derby
together...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there anything we can do, Trainer?
There has
to be a way we can run
together...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think long and hard, but can't come up
with
anything. I look at Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I did... I wanted nothing more than to
debut at
the same time as Kita.
choice_data_list: ダイヤ、ギリギリまで待ったんだよな？
ダイヤ、ギリギリまで待ったんだよね？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But it's not possible to wait any longer...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If I'm not race-ready now, then there's
no way I'll
be ready in time to debut.
And if this is the case...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I should stop training in preparation for
my debut
and go back to basic training
for now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If I overwork myself and get injured, the
Satono
family's dream of winning a G1
race for the first
time would go down
with me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can't possibly risk that happening,
which is why I
decided to postpone my
debut to next year.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That was my family's consensus.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So are you doing this just because your
family
told you to?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it, Kita. It's because I
know I have
to.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Our friendship means the world to me...
But just
like how you want to make
everyone smile,
there's something
important I must do too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to stay your friend while
protecting what's
important to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If our positions were reversed, I wouldn't
want
you to sacrifice what's important to
you for my
sake, either.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So please. Please understand my
situation.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay. I got it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is exactly why I wanted to be
friends with
you, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But... it does look like I'll have to tough
it out.
Even though it'll be lonely out on
the track
without you running after me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Do you really think I won't be running
after you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do you mean? I thought we
won't be
running in the same races
together?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but think of the bigger picture.
Imagine
you're looking at things from a
bird's-eye view,
high in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You start off running just a little before I
do. Then
afterwards, I follow in your
exact footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It'll still look like I'm running after you
from that
perspective, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh... You are right! Great thinking, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It'll be just like back then...

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Kita! Wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Dia! This way! Watch your step
and be
careful not to trip!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Just walk where I walk, and you'll be
okay! Get
ready to see something you've
never seen before!

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Whoa... This is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Right? I'll keep showing you lots and
lots of sights
that you can't see from
your home! Always and
forever!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll still be friends with me,
Kita. I know
we'll have different training
schedules and won't
get to see each
other as often, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll always keep you in my
sights. I'll be
cheering for you while
running after you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia... Of course! We've never actually
had to take
different paths before up
until now...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But I promise you! I'll work hard with
Trainer to
pave the way for you, just like
the big sister I am!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The path that the two friends have
always
trekked on together now
diverges into different
routes. But even
so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I believe that their time apart will make
them
both stronger in the end. But for
now, Kitasan
Black must walk alone.
